d: Platinum white hair is styled with long straight lengths, bangs framing the face, and a high bun held by a red ribbon. The eyes are a vivid amber-orange with a cheerful, wide-eyed expression on a youthful face with a slender, curvaceous build. The outfit is a white and pink frilled bikini with a gold star ornament and a matching pink halter neck, accessorized with a blue and gold beaded bracelet and blue painted fingernails. Pointed elf ears and two short, curved black horns protrude from the head, complemented by a red tropical flower hair ornament.
